shared_elements: schematic human/anthropomorphic face carved in relief on an upright slab
brow ridge rendered as a continuous horizontal bar
elongated nose as a vertical ridge
eyes as recessed hollows or ovals under the brow
frontal, symmetrical, flat-slab figure with squared outline
justification: Both surfaces present an upright rectangular slab bearing a frontal, highly schematic anthropomorphic face in which a continuous horizontal brow bar joins a long vertical nose ridge with hollow eyes beneath, a distinctive and conventional formula rather than a naturalistic head. The main difference is that B extends far beyond the head into a full torso with additional carved motifs (paired incised elements at the top, a prominent circular disc on the chest, arcs and a belt-like band with vertical strokes), whereas A shows only the isolated face on a small plain slab with no body or secondary motifs.
